items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: I remember that because I played in that place with Kit Thomas several times.

ctx.x: Eagle Eye, yeah. Yeah, Eagle Eye Hall.

Is that the one they tore down? Oh yeah, that was just on the line there. Well the Elks you still have them eating there too at Eagle Eye Hall. That's just on the line where the New Orleans and Algea's bridge comes across the river. Well I remember that because I played in that place with Kit Thomas several times.

I have some of those pictures I think I have wrote down on the back of one of them. See if I can find the name of that. The Green Hall. I don't think that's so much junk here it can't even pick it up. The Alisons have already passed. We're going to have to go there. I was going to ask some more. I'll be looking for this but it's going to take me ten minutes to find it.
